purpose: Guard OdfKit's ability to decrypt password-protected ODF packages produced by other implementations. 守護 OdfKit 解密他家實作所產生之密碼保護 ODF 封裝的能力。
cleanRoomPolicy: Fixture content is authored by OdfKit (a single paragraph written through TextDocument); LibreOffice is used only to apply ODF package encryption. No LibreOffice source, template, or bundled asset is copied.

producer.method: UNO storeToURL with FilterName=writer8 and a Password property, after setting /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/ODF DefaultVersion.

fixtures.notes: ODF 1.0/1.1 legacy per-entry encryption. Omits manifest:key-size and manifest:start-key-generation, so consumers must apply the specified defaults (16 bytes, SHA-1). Cipher feedback width is the full 64-bit block despite the specification text saying 8-bit CFB.
ODF 1.2/1.3 legacy per-entry encryption. The start key uses SHA-256 while the PBKDF2 pseudo-random function stays HMAC-SHA-1 per Part 2 4.16.7; conflating the two derives the wrong key.

LibreOffice 24.8+ default for ODF 1.4 (wholesome encryption). The ZIP holds only mimetype, encrypted-package and the manifest; encrypted-package is IV(12) || AES-256-GCM ciphertext || tag(16) over the deflated inner ODF package. The key is Argon2id(SHA-256(password), salt) and there is no per-entry checksum because the AEAD tag covers integrity.

expectedText: OdfKit encryption interop fixture / 加密互通測試素材
regenerate: See docs/odf-format-support.md. Regeneration requires a local LibreOffice; the fixtures are committed so that the decryption contract is verifiable without external tooling.
